00023 /**
00024  * @brief Definitions for container attributes
00025  */
00026 typedef enum HxContainerAttributes_t
00027 {
00028     kHxContainerAttrNone            = 0x00000000,
00029     
00030     /**
00031      * @brief The container receives focus, with a focus ring drawn around
00032      * the container when the container has the focus.  
00033      */
00034     kHxContainerAttrFocusable       = 0x00000001,
00035 
00036     /**
00037      * @brief Set the kHxContainerAttrNoFocusRing attribute if the container
00038      * is focusable, but should not have a focus ring drawn around it.  This
00039      * is sometimes desired for the main content container, like the web
00040      * content container or the text document container.  Because the
00041      * container is focusable, it can also receive input events, such as
00042      * scroll wheel events.
00043      */
00044     kHxContainerAttrNoFocusRing     = 0x00000002,
00045     
00046     /**
00047      * @brief The container is drawn with a frame.
00048      */
00049     kHxContainerAttrHasFrame        = 0x00000004,   
00050     
00051     /**
00052      * @brief The container has a control that the user can use to
00053      * resize the container horizontally.  A frame is always drawn
00054      * with the resizer.  This feature is not implemented in the
00055      * current platform release, but the flag bit is reserved for a
00056      * future implementation.
00057      */
00058     kHxContainerAttrHasResizerH     = 0x00000008,
00059 
00060     /**
00061      * @brief The container has a control that the user can use to
00062      * resize the container vertically.  A frame is always drawn with
00063      * the resizer.  This feature is not implemented in the current
00064      * platform release, but the flag bit is reserved for a future
00065      * implementation.
00066      */
00067     kHxContainerAttrHasResizerV     = 0x00000010,
00068 
00069     /**
00070      * @brief Set the kHxContainerAttrKeepTabs attribute if tabs should not
00071      * be passed on to the system for changing widget focus.  If this
00072      * attribute is set, tabs do not change focus when the container, or any
00073      * of the container's children, have focus.
00074      */
00075     kHxContainerAttrKeepTabs        = 0x00000020,
00076 
00077     /**
00078      * @brief Set the kHxContainerAttrKeepEnters attribute if pressing the
00079      * Enter key should not be passed on to the system for acting on a command
00080      * button that is not a child of the container.
00081      */
00082     kHxContainerAttrKeepEnters      = 0x00000040,
00083 
00084     /**
00085      * @brief Set the kHxContainerAttrKeepEvents attribute if events
00086      * should not be passed on to children of the container. Instead, the
00087      * container's event handlers will be called.
00088      */
00089 
00090     kHxContainerAttrKeepEvents      = 0x00000080,
00091 
00092 
00093     /**
00094      * @brief Set the kHxContainerAttrRoundedBottom attribute if the bottom
00095      * left and bottom right corners of the container should instead have
00096      * rounded edges in place of the corner. kHxContainerAttrHasFrame must
00097      * also be specified for this to take effect.
00098      */
00099 
00100     kHxContainerAttrRoundedBottom   = 0x00000100,
00101 
00102     kHxContainerAttrAll =   kHxContainerAttrFocusable
00103                             | kHxContainerAttrNoFocusRing
00104                             | kHxContainerAttrHasFrame
00105                             | kHxContainerAttrHasResizerH
00106                             | kHxContainerAttrHasResizerV
00107                             | kHxContainerAttrKeepTabs
00108                             | kHxContainerAttrKeepEnters
00109                             | kHxContainerAttrKeepEvents
00110                             | kHxContainerAttrRoundedBottom
00111 } HxContainerAttributes_t;

00119 /**
00120  * @brief               Create a container widget 
00121  *
00122  * HxContainerNew creates a container widget, which can be used to group
00123  * widgets in a scrollable pane.
00124  *
00125  * The container is the parent of its contained widgets.  The children
00126  * widgets placed in a container are positioned relative to the container's
00127  * origin:  a child with a top-left origin of (0,0) is positioned at the
00128  * top left corner of the container.
00129  *
00130  * The attr argument can be a logically OR'ed set of HxContainerAttributes_t
00131  * fags.
00132  *
00133  * @param id            IN:     Unique ID for the widget, defined by app,
00134  *                              or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
00135  * @param pParent       IN:     Pointer to the container's parent widget
00136  * @param pBounds       IN:     Pointer to the container bounds
00137  * @param attr          IN:     One or more HxContainerAttributes_t flags
00138  * @param hContainer    OUT:    Handle to the created container
00139  *
00140  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00141  *                              HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails,
00142  *                              and sets *hContainer to NULL.
00143  *                              HX_INVALID_ARG if size is too small for the
00144  *                              specified attributes.
00145  *
00146  **/
00147 HxResult HxContainerNew(uint32_t id, HxWidget_t* pParent,
00148                     const HxRectangle_t* pBounds, HxContainerAttributes_t attr,
00149                     HxContainer_t** hContainer);
00150             
00151 /**
00152  * @brief               Delete a container widget
00153  *
00154  * HxContainerDelete deletes a container created from an earlier call to
00155  * HxContainerNew.
00156  *
00157  * It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application,
00158  * since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is
00159  * deleted.  HxContainerDelete only needs to be called when removing a
00160  * container at runtime.
00161  *
00162  * @param pContainer    IN:     Pointer to the container to delete
00163  *
00164  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00165  *
00166  **/
00167 HxResult HxContainerDelete(HxContainer_t* pContainer);

00169 /**
00170  * @brief               Scroll the widgets within a container
00171  *
00172  * HxContainerScroll scrolls all the child widgets within a container by delta
00173  * pixels. The widgets scroll either horizontally or vertically, based on the
00174  * scrollAttr argument.
00175  *
00176  * delta is negative or positive depending on the scrolling direction.  For
00177  * example, to scroll widgets up, delta is negative.
00178  *
00179  * @param pContainer    IN:     Pointer to a container
00180  * @param scrollAttr    IN:     Scrollbar attribute (vertical vs horizontal)
00181  * @param delta         IN:     Number of pixels to scroll
00182  *
00183  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00184  *
00185  **/
00186 HxResult HxContainerScroll(HxContainer_t* pContainer,
00187                             HxScrollbarAttributes_t scrollAttr, int32_t delta);
